summary: Learn to govern digital transformation with COBIT 2019, dashboards, and executive reporting. Build oversight you can use immediately.
lede: Digital transformation governance gives executives and senior professionals a structured way to oversee portfolios and change initiatives. The course develops skills in mapping decision rights, assessing maturity, prioritizing investments, tracking benefits and risks, and reporting progress through executive scorecards and board packs.
audienceIntro: This course is built for executives and senior professionals who need to govern digital transformation with clearer decision rights, stronger oversight, and measurable accountability.
modules: Governance Roadmap and Executive Action Plan
prerequisites: To benefit fully from this course, you should have working familiarity with executive decision-making, transformation programmes, or IT-enabled change initiatives. Prior experience with portfolio governance, PMO reporting, service management, or digital strategy is helpful, but no coding or programming is required. If you already use dashboards, risk registers, or steering committee papers, you will be able to apply the course immediately; if not, you will still be able to work through the governance templates and executive tools introduced during the training.
